params.name: Line Manager
params.tooltip: Cargo, vehicle count and balance in line rows; load, condition and age in vehicle rows; the model row above the vehicles; a question before cloning or replacing several vehicles.

params.name: Select Terminals
params.tooltip: Three buttons per terminal instead of the drop-down list; the preferred terminal highlighted; terminals the line cannot use or reach greyed, with the reason.

params.name: Station window: Select Terminals
params.tooltip: A Select Terminals button for each line stop in the station window's terminal list.

params.name: Line window
params.tooltip: Load and condition of each vehicle, Add Vehicle and Remove Vehicle, and the Stops card with what waits at each stop.

params.name: Vehicle hover on the map
params.tooltip: Line, next stop, speed, load, condition and delivery quality under a vehicle's name.

params.name: Vehicle performance
params.tooltip: The Performance card in the vehicle window and the slope speeds in the vehicle store.

params.name: Statistics
params.tooltip: Quick filters, totals and corrected sorting in the Lines, Vehicles, Stations and Warehouses tabs.

params.name: Finances
params.tooltip: Income statement, cash flow and balance sheet in the Finances tab.

params.name: Windows side by side
params.tooltip: Statistics, Line Manager, Finances, Company and the notification log stay open side by side and when you click the map.

params.name: Minimize button
params.tooltip: A button in the title bar of every window that folds it to its title bar.

params.name: Entity windows
params.tooltip: Sections stay open, Sell needs a second click, the town window names what limits growth, a locked perk says when a promotion is pending.

params.name: Industry window
params.tooltip: The Development and Served by cards, and the switch for the red area of a blocked expansion.

params.name: Construction menus
params.tooltip: Rail and Tracks, Road and Roads show each other's tabs; fastest track first; Configure opens the right tab; the bulldozer warns before removing a station that lines stop at.

params.name: Build tooltip measurements
params.tooltip: Steepest gradient, tightest curve radius, height range, bridge height and tunnel depth while you draw track or road.

params.name: Sliders
params.tooltip: The mouse wheel moves a slider one step, and a value can be typed.

params.name: Notifications
params.tooltip: Notifications of the same kind share one icon with a count, in darker colours with more contrast.

params.name: Catchment area buttons
params.tooltip: Two buttons in the game bar that keep the passenger and the cargo catchment areas of all stations on the map.

params.name: Subsidies
params.tooltip: Subsidy icons coloured by state, with the time until an offer ends and the time left.

params.name: Earnings tooltip
params.tooltip: The cash flow of the last 30 days and of the 30 days before in the Earnings tooltip.

params.name: Vehicle store: newest first
params.tooltip: The vehicle store lists the newest models first and preselects the newest one.
